scope: Production acquisition while automatic day-end timelapse task 14213 encodes; bounded before 20:00

capture_defect.interpretation: One exposure aborted by the existing per-exposure watchdog, followed by successful recovery. Not a permanently stopped camera. Root cause of the timeout under load remains unproven.

resource_snapshot.interpretation: FFmpeg already has low CPU priority. No scheduling or timeout settings changed from this observation.

limits: Observational coincidence with encoding does not prove that FFmpeg caused the timeout.
Existing preview-fsync correction is not presented as fixing this capture failure.
No hardware settings, memory reservation or watchdog limits changed without a demonstrated remedy.
Live acceptance ends at 20:00 Europe/Zurich; no subsequent live stability claim or 24-hour observation.

results.reason: Unread output pipe prevents child completion

local_driver_reproduction.scope: Actual output-selection AST from the driver, with a real child writing 4 MiB and a two-second bounded wait. No camera or production process involved.
local_driver_reproduction.conclusion: Unread PIPE deadlock reproduced for full profiles; images_only mode completes using its existing temporary file. This does not establish that the production timeout had the same cause.
